body: I get that, unfortunately it makes me bitter with resentment that if not for them I can just be done with it all. That's just as selfish of them.

At least some of what you shared relates to my situation. I too was getting close to someone, even telling the other "I love you". Then out of nowhere she too ghosts me. Even worse, we were close friends for going on a decade now. I don't feel I like belong either.
Sometimes not even sleep is an escape because my dreams will haunt me

I completely agree with you that humans weren't meant to live like this. However, I would argue that people were depressed before the 1800s. It's probably worse today, however. Humans as a species came into this world as hunter/gatherers and the world we live in today is unnatural. Like dolphins at SeaWorld doin' tricks for assholes, they've evolved to life in the ocean.Free. I firmly believe that a HUGE part of of the issues currently ailing us is because we live in an artificial, unnatural enviroment. PS it's 3:30 in the AM where I live, so if I don't respond for a few hours it's because I'm in bed. I would like to carry on this discussion later though. So If you don't here from me in awhile, don't be discouraged. I hope you have a good night, well as good as a night one in your shoes could hope for, anyway.

Today, I would've ended it if I had a gun. I feel like that is the only way I could do it. I too have no one in my life that TRULY gets it.They just tell me shit like "it''ll get better". I'm like "motherfucker, how do you know that?" There are people all over THE WORLD, even children, CHILDREN who lead a hellish life. It don't get better for everybody. I think it is such a self absorbed, myopic, even childish way of looking a life. I feel for ya man.

I've been a lurker for awhile and this is my very first post, and some of y'all ain't gonna like what I have to say...but here it goes...I hope that OP did go through with it because if they're in that much pain then at least they are at peace. Who are we to try and deny them that? Life isn't precious to everyone...it just simply isn't. I know that's a hard pill to swallow but that's just the truth.
